Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, and lymphopenia, with elevated basophils and alkaline phosphatase. There is also mild hyperchloremia and low total CO₂, suggesting possible metabolic acidosis. Liver transaminases are low. These findings may indicate a systemic process such as infection, inflammation, or bone marrow suppression. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
